predictionObjective.grain: species × fishing location × local one-hour interval
predictionObjective.target: calibrated probability of at least one catch of the named species during that interval
predictionObjective.labelRequirement: verified positive and no-catch intervals with fishing effort recorded
predictionObjective.validationRequirement: held-out locations and future time periods; probability calibration and uncertainty reported
predictionObjective.status: target defined; training and forecast validation not yet available

sources.name: GTM Reserve water-quality network
sources.access: NERRS Centralized Data Management Office (CDMO) System-Wide Monitoring Program
sources.notes: Use station metadata and QA/QC flags. CDMO web services require authorization and a static IP; confirm access before designing automated polling.

sources.name: FWC Fisheries-Independent Monitoring
sources.availability: historical survey records; ArcGIS query service
sources.access: FWC Inshore Saltwater FIM Stratified Random Sampling Records
sources.notes: Survey abundance and size are independent monitoring indices, not direct angler catch odds. Retain sampling gear, habitat, effort, and survey design metadata.

sources.name: NOAA MRMS rainfall estimates
sources.access: NOAA/NCEP MRMS and NOAA precipitation data access
sources.notes: Aggregate gridded QPE over hydrologically connected catchments; do not substitute a point rainfall value for watershed runoff.

sources.name: Verified fishing-trip outcomes
sources.availability: angler-reported; currently device-local catch log exists
sources.access: V5 local catch log; future validation dataset requires explicit consent and verification rules
sources.integrationStatus: partial; catch logging exists, but records do not train or validate the engine
sources.notes: Keep personal records local unless the user explicitly opts in to contribution. Define verified trip, no-catch, effort, and duplicate rules before modeling.

sources.name: USGS / SJRWMD hydrologic monitoring
sources.availability: near-real-time sensors and historical series; station coverage varies
sources.access: USGS Water Data APIs and SJRWMD hydrologic data portal
sources.integrationStatus: catalogued; station and watershed mapping pending
sources.notes: Prefer modern USGS Water Data APIs; legacy WaterServices is scheduled for decommissioning in 2027. Normalize vertical datums and distinguish stage from discharge.

sources.name: NOAA observed water levels
sources.availability: near-real-time preliminary and verified observations; station coverage varies
sources.access: NOAA CO-OPS Data API, water_level product
sources.notes: Join observations to predictions at the same station, timestamp, and datum. Mark preliminary versus verified values.

sources.name: NOAA / FDEP coastal elevation surveys
sources.availability: periodic survey archives; spatial and temporal coverage varies
sources.access: FDEP Regional Coastal Monitoring / Historic Shoreline data; NOAA Bathymetric Data Viewer and Digital Coast lidar
sources.notes: Preserve survey date, horizontal and vertical datum, resolution, and source. Profiles are not real-time beach conditions.

sources.name: NOAA CoastWatch satellite data
newInformation: turbidity or optical water clarity proxies
sources.availability: gridded satellite products; cloud, swath, and quality-mask gaps apply
sources.access: NOAA CoastWatch East Coast node and ERDDAP
sources.integrationStatus: catalogued; product and quality-mask selection pending
sources.notes: Use quality flags and pixel age; cloud cover and nearshore optical artifacts can make a pixel unavailable or misleading.

sources.name: Florida DEP water-quality archives
sources.availability: discrete historical samples; station and parameter coverage varies
sources.access: Florida DEP Watershed Information Network reports and STORET Public Access
sources.integrationStatus: catalogued; archive extraction and QA harmonization pending
sources.notes: WIN is the current centralized system for non-regulatory discrete water-quality data; Florida STORET is retained as a legacy system. Preserve lab method, units, detection limits, and QA status.
